01 / ABOUT NOOR

I’m a Chicago creator building my work at the intersection of short-form video, marketing, and everyday culture.

I’m Noor Nubani. I have a degree in advertising, a minor in business, and I’m about to earn my master’s in digital marketing. I’m building a creative career in marketing and social media, with a UGC focus on beauty, fashion, and tech.

Having lived in Jeddah and Dubai and now based in Chicago, I bring a perspective shaped by different cities and cultures to the way I tell stories. My current work explores daily rituals, wellness, and travel through vertical video. Next, I’m expanding that portfolio with product-led skincare demos, fashion styling stories, and straightforward tech reviews.
